title: Narmada Faith Day — Poicha, Garudeshwar & the River Temples

stops.note: Morning darshan and the exhibitions before crowds build
Datta samadhi; reach within the evening window
End on the riverbank at Gora

day_notes.note: Poicha → Rajpipla (lunch) → Garudeshwar → Gora runs ~90 km of easy roads. With an extra half-day, extend west to Kabirvad's banyan island via the Bharuch-side ghat (boat crossing, ₹20–40).

notes: All three sites are free-entry, active places of worship — modest dress, footwear off at shrines. Shravan and Datta Jayanti transform the crowd levels.
